نفتكر (form VIII)
# نَفْتَكِرُ (naftakiru) /naf.ta.ki.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَكَرَ (iftakara)
# نُفْتَكَرُ (nuftakaru) /nuf.ta.ka.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَكَرَ (iftakara)
# نَفْتَكِرَ (naftakira) /naf.ta.ki.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَكَرَ (iftakara)
# نُفْتَكَرَ (nuftakara) /nuf.ta.ka.ra/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
